subject: english
question:
Select the correct option:
The architect argued that aesthetics should not be subordinated ____ functionality.
solution:
The correct answer is '**to**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct preposition to use in this context is "**to**."
 
• The phrase "subordinated to" is commonly used to indicate that one thing is made secondary or less important compared to another.
 
• Options 1 (at), 2
